whatThisPluginAdds.text: Theme Foundation provides the shared public layouts, runtime design tokens, layout defaults, and override contracts used by Capell themes. It renders host-owned page data and does not introduce a separate content model.

surfaceOutcome.text: Use Preview Foundation Theme on existing content before Apply Foundation Theme, which changes the selected site's public design; reapply its previous theme to restore that selection. Shared Theme Studio settings saves can affect public pages. For fictional demo content, name a disposable target with --site and review --base-url and --language; unscoped setup refuses existing sites, scoped repeats preserve site configuration unless --force deliberately replaces its theme, enabled state, requested site translations and domains, while demo pages, widgets and demo layouts are rewritten on scoped repeats.

developers.text: The package centralizes theme registration, token resolution, layout defaults, and public-output safety contracts for the theme fleet.

teams.text: Teams get a consistent baseline for site chrome, layout behavior, and design settings across Capell themes.
